definitions.explanation: A high-pitched voice produced by vibrating only the edges of the vocal cords, as opposed to one's normal chest voice.

examples.japanese: {裏声|うらごえ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歌|うた}った→歌う：00684_utau⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦サビ→サビ：22298_sabi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{裏声|うらごえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: This song uses falsetto in the chorus.

examples.japanese: ⟦カラオケ→カラオケ：05080_karaoke⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歌|うた}おう→歌う：00684_utau⟧としたら{裏声|うらごえ}になってしまった。
examples.english: When I tried to sing a high-pitched song at karaoke, my voice flipped into falsetto.

notes:
USAGE: {裏声|うらごえ} literally means 'back voice' or 'reverse voice,' contrasting with ⟦{地声|じごえ}→地声：19937_jigoe⟧ (natural voice, chest voice). Common in music and singing contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {裏声|うらごえ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歌|うた}う→歌う：00684_utau⟧: to sing in falsetto
- {裏声|うらごえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use falsetto
- {裏声|うらごえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to flip into falsetto
- {裏声|うらごえ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to be able to produce falsetto

CONTRAST: {裏声|うらごえ} (falsetto) vs. ⟦{地声|じごえ}→地声：19937_jigoe⟧ (natural/chest voice).
